Haa Meem
Yeh Khuda-e-Rehmaan o Raheem ki tanzeel hai
Is kitaab ki aayatein tafseel ke saath bayaan ki gayi hain, Arabi zabaan ka Quran hai us qaum ke liye jo samajhne waali ho
Yeh Quran bashaarat dene waala aur azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala bana kar naazil kiya gaya hai, lekin aksariyat ne is se e'raaz kiya hai aur woh kuch sunte hi nahin hain

Aur kehte hain ke hamaare dil jin baaton ki tum daawat de rahe ho un ki taraf se parde mein hain, aur hamaare kaanon mein behraapan hai, aur hamaare tumhaare darmiyaan parda haail hai, lihaaza tum apna kaam karo aur hum apna kaam kar rahe hain

Aap keh dijiye ke main bhi tumhaara hi jaisa bashar hoon, lekin meri taraf baraabar wahi aati hai ke tumhaara khuda ek hai, lihaaza us ke liye istiqaamat karo aur us se istighfaar karo, aur mushrikon ke haal par afsos hai
Jo log zakaat ada nahin karte hain aur aakhirat ka inkaar karne waale hain
Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye munqata na hone waala ajr hai
Aap keh dijiye ke kya tum log us Khuda ka inkaar karte ho jis ne saari zameen ko do din mein paida kar diya hai, aur us ka misl qaraar dete ho, jab ke woh aalameen ka paalne waala hai

Aur us ne is zameen mein oopar se pahaad qaraar de diye hain aur barakat rakh di hai, aur chaar din ke andar tamaam saamaan-e-ma'eeshat ko muqarrar kar diya hai jo tamaam talabgaaron ke liye musaawi haisiyat rakhta hai
Us ke baad us ne aasmaan ka rukh kiya jo bilkul dhuaan tha, aur use aur zameen ko hukm diya ke ba-khushi ya ba-karaahat hamaari taraf aao, to dono ne arz ki ke hum itaa'at-guzaar ban kar haazir hain

Phir un aasmaanon ko do din ke andar saat aasmaan bana diye aur har aasmaan mein us ke mu'aamle ki wahi kar di, aur hum ne aasmaan-e-duniya ko chiraaghon se aaraasta kar diya hai aur mahfooz bhi bana diya hai, ke yeh Khuda-e-Azeez o Aleem ki muqarrar ki hui taqdeer hai
Phir agar yeh e'raaz karein to keh dijiye ke hum ne tum ko waisi hi bijli ke azaab se daraaya hai jaisi qaum-e-Aad o Samood par naazil hui thi

Jab un ke paas saamne aur peechhe se hamaare numaainde aaye ke Allah ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karo, to unhon ne keh diya ke hamaara khuda chaahta to malaaika ko naazil karta, hum tumhaare paighaam ke qubool karne waale nahin hain

Phir qaum-e-Aad ne zameen mein na-haq bulandi aur bartari se kaam liya aur yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke hum se zyaada taaqat waala kaun hai. To kya un logon ne yeh nahin dekha ke jis ne un sab ko paida kiya hai woh bahar-haal un se zyaada taaqat rakhne waala hai? Lekin yeh log hamaari nishaaniyon ka inkaar karne waale the

To hum ne bhi un ke oopar tez o tund aandhi ko un ki nahoosat ke dinon mein bhej diya taake inhein zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhi ruswaai ke azaab ka maza chakhaayein, aur aakhirat ka azaab to zyaada ruswa-kun hai, aur wahaan un ki koi madad bhi nahin ki jaaegi

Aur qaum-e-Samood ko bhi hum ne hidaayat di, lekin un logon ne gumraahi ko hidaayat ke muqaable mein zyaada pasand kiya, to zillat ke azaab ki bijli ne inhein apni giraft mein le liya un aamaal ki bina par jo woh anjaam de rahe the
Aur hum ne un logon ko najaat de di jo imaan laane waale aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karne waale the
Aur jis din dushmanaan-e-Khuda ko Jahannam ki taraf dhakela jaaega, phir inhein zajr o taubeekh ki jaaegi
Yahaan tak ke jab sab Jahannam ke paas aayenge to un ke kaan aur un ki aankhein aur jild sab un ke aamaal ke baare mein un ke khilaaf gawaahi denge

Aur woh apne a'za se kahenge ke tum ne hamaare khilaaf kaise shahaadat de di? To woh jawaab denge ke humein usi Khuda ne goya banaaya hai jis ne sab ko goyaai ata ki hai, aur tum ko bhi pehle din usi ne paida kiya hai aur ab bhi palat kar usi ki baargaah mein jaaoge

Aur tum is baat se parda-poshi nahin karte the ke kahin tumhaare khilaaf tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhein aur gosht-post gawaahi na de dein, balke tumhaara khayaal yeh tha ke Allah tumhaare bahut se aamaal se baakhabar bhi nahin hai
Aur yahi khayaal jo tum ne apne Parwardigar ke baare mein qaaim kiya tha usi ne tumhein halaak kar diya hai, aur tum khasaare waalon mein ho gaye ho
Ab agar yeh bardaasht karein to bhi un ka thikaana Jahannam hai, aur agar ma'zarat karna chaahein to bhi ma'zarat qubool nahin ki jaaegi

Aur hum ne khud bhi un ke liye ham-nasheen faraaham kar diye the jinhon ne un ke agle pichhle tamaam umoor un ki nazron mein aaraasta kar diye the, aur un par bhi wahi azaab saabit ho gaya jo un se pehle insaan aur jinnaat ke girohon par saabit ho chuka tha, ke yeh sab ke sab khasaare waalon mein the
Aur kuffaar aapas mein kehte hain ke is Quran ko hargiz mat suno aur is ki tilaawat ke waqt hangaama karo, shaayad isi tarah un par ghaalib aa jaao
To ab hum un kufr karne waalon ko shadeed azaab ka maza chakhaayenge aur inhein un ke aamaal ki badtareen saza denge
Yeh dushmanaan-e-Khuda ki saheeh saza Jahannam hai jis mein un ka hameshgi ka ghar hai, jo is baat ki saza hai ke yeh aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka inkaar kiya karte the

Aur kuffaar yeh faryaad karenge ke Parwardigar! Humein jinnaat o insaan ke un logon ko dikhla de jinhon ne hum ko gumraah kiya tha taake hum inhein apne qadmon ke neeche qaraar de dein, aur is tarah woh past logon mein shaamil ho jaayein

Beshak jin logon ne yeh kaha ke Allah hamaara Rab hai aur usi par jame rahe un par malaaika yeh paighaam le kar naazil hote hain ke daro nahin aur ranjeeda bhi na ho, aur us Jannat se masroor ho jaao jis ka tum se waada kiya ja raha hai

Hum zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhi tumhaare saathi the aur aakhirat mein bhi tumhaare saathi hain. Yahaan Jannat mein tumhaare liye woh tamaam cheezein faraaham hain jin ke liye tumhaara dil chaahta hai aur jinhein tum talab karoge
Yeh bahut zyaada bakhshne waale meharbaan Parwardigar ki taraf se tumhaari ziyaafat ka saamaan hai
Aur us se zyaada behtar baat kis ki hogi jo logon ko Allah ki taraf daawat de aur nek amal bhi kare aur yeh kahe ke main us ke itaa'at-guzaaron mein se hoon
Neki aur buraai baraabar nahin ho sakti, lihaaza tum buraai ka jawaab behtareen tareeqe se do, ke is tarah jis ke aur tumhaare darmiyaan adaawat hai woh bhi aisa ho jaaega jaise gehra dost hota hai
Aur yeh salaahiyat unhi ko naseeb hoti hai jo sabr karne waale hote hain, aur yeh baat unhi ko haasil hoti hai jo badi qismat waale hote hain
Aur jab tum mein Shaitaan ki taraf se koi waswasa paida ho to Allah ki panaah talab karo, ke woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab ka jaanne waala hai

Aur usi Khuda ki nishaaniyon mein se raat o din aur aaftaab o maahtaab hain, lihaaza aaftaab o maahtaab ko sajda na karo balke us Khuda ko sajda karo jis ne un sab ko paida kiya hai, agar waaqai us ke ibaadat karne waale ho
Phir agar yeh log akad se kaam lein to lein, jo log Parwardigar ki baargaah mein hain woh din raat us ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain aur kisi waqt bhi thakte nahin hain

Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke tum zameen ko saaf aur murda dekh rahe ho, aur phir jab hum ne paani barsa diya to zameen lehlahaane lagi aur us mein nashw o numa paida ho gayi. Beshak jis ne zameen ko zinda kiya hai wahi murdon ka zinda karne waala bhi hai, aur yaqeenan woh har shai par qaadir hai

Beshak jo log hamaari aayaat mein hera-pheri karte hain woh hum se chhupne waale nahin hain. Socho ke jo shakhs Jahannam mein daal diya jaaega woh behtar hai ya jo roz-e-qiyaamat be-khauf o khatar nazar aaye? Tum jo chaaho amal karo, woh tumhaare tamaam aamaal ka dekhne waala hai
Beshak jin logon ne Quran ke aane ke baad us ka inkaar kar diya un ka anjaam bura hai, aur yeh ek aali-martaba kitaab hai
Jis ke qareeb saamne ya peechhe kisi taraf se baatil aa bhi nahin sakta hai, ke yeh Khuda-e-Hakeem o Hameed ki naazil ki hui kitaab hai
Paighambar! Aap se jo kuch bhi kaha jaata hai yeh sab aap se pehle waale rasoolon se kaha ja chuka hai, aur aap ka Parwardigar bakhshne waala bhi hai aur dardnaak azaab ka maalik bhi hai

Aur agar hum is Quran ko Ajami zabaan mein naazil kar dete to yeh kehte ke is ki aayatein waazeh kyon nahin hain, aur yeh Ajami kitaab aur Arabi insaan ka rabt kya hai. To aap keh dijiye ke yeh kitaab saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye shifa aur hidaayat hai, aur jo log imaan nahin rakhte hain un ke kaanon mein behraapan hai aur woh un ko nazar bhi nahin aa raha hai, aur un logon ko bahut door se pukaara jaaega

Aur yaqeenan hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di to us mein bhi jhagda daal diya gaya, aur agar aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se ek baat pehle se tai na ho gayi hoti to ab tak un ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya gaya hota, aur yaqeenan yeh bade bechain kar dene waale shak mein mubtala hain
Jo bhi nek amal karega woh apne liye karega, aur jo bura karega us ka zimmedaar bhi woh khud hi hoga, aur aap ka Parwardigar bandon par zulm karne waala nahin hai

Qiyaamat ka ilm usi ki taraf palta diya jaata hai, aur ghilaafon se jo phal nikalte hain ya auraton ko jo haml hota hai ya jin bachchon ko woh paida karti hain yeh sab usi ke ilm ke mutaabiq hote hain. Aur jis din woh pukaar kar poochhega ke mere shuraka kahaan hain, to mushrikeen majbooran arz karenge ke hum pehle hi bata chuke hain ke hum mein se koi un se waaqif nahin hai
Aur woh sab gum ho jaayenge jinhein yeh pehle pukaara karte the, aur ab khayaal hoga ke koi chhutkaara mumkin nahin hai
Insaan bhalaai ki dua karte hue kabhi nahin thakta hai, aur jab koi takleef use chhoo bhi leti hai to bilkul maayoos aur be-aas ho jaata hai

Aur agar hum us takleef ke baad phir use rehmat ka maza chakha dein to fauran yeh keh dega ke yeh to mera haq hai, aur mujhe to khayaal bhi nahin hai ke qiyaamat qaaim hone waali hai, aur agar main Parwardigar ki taraf palataaya bhi gaya to mere liye wahaan bhi nekiyaan hi hain. To phir hum bhi kuffaar ko zaroor bataayenge ke unhon ne kya kya kiya hai aur inhein sakht azaab ka maza chakhaayenge
Aur hum jab insaan ko ne'mat dete hain to hum se kinaara-kash ho jaata hai aur pehlu badal kar alag ho jaata hai, aur jab buraai pahunch jaati hai to khoob lambi chaudi duaayein karne lagta hai
Aap keh dijiye ke kya tumhein yeh khayaal hai ke agar yeh Quran Khuda ki taraf se hai aur tum ne us ka inkaar kar diya, to us se zyaada kaun gumraah hoga jo us se itna sakht ikhtilaaf karne waala ho

Hum anqareeb apni nishaaniyon ko tamaam atraaf-e-aalam mein aur khud un ke nafs ke andar dikhlaayenge taake un par yeh baat waazeh ho jaaye ke woh barhaq hai. Aur kya Parwardigar ke liye yeh baat kaafi nahin hai ke woh har shai ka gawaah aur sab ka dekhne waala hai
Aagaah ho jaao ke yeh log Allah se mulaaqaat ki taraf se shak mein mubtala hain, aur aagaah ho jaao ke Allah har shai par ihaata kiye hue hai
